Name: Mahjong Advisor
Author: Akari
Punchline: Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.
Description:
Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and recommends a discard, ranked by hand speed against deal-in risk. Auto-play and file logging are on by default in this build: sit at a casual table and it plays, then /mjadv bundle packages the logs for support. /mjadv stop or the Automation tab returns to manual suggestions instantly.

Discard piles and called-meld strips are found automatically. /mjadv nodes is only needed if detection fails on your client.
